task: INTiana Guide selected-gear Doubleshot read-only audit
method: Scoped text and metadata transcribed from the internal browser's returned accessibility and read-only rendered-DOM observations. These are excerpts, not raw HTTP responses, a complete page archive, historical-revision byte authentication, or live-game observations. Timestamps are the actual browser-read intervals; report compilation occurs later.

wiki_attribution.derivative_notice: The scoped excerpts below are attributed to their individual source URLs. Excerpt selection and audit annotations are additions; original source wording is retained where labeled exact.

common_limits: Anonymous cached Wiki pages were observed. Literal cache notices are retained, including the anomalous negative value on Augment Slot; they do not establish cache freshness independently.
Displayed Permanent link URLs identify page metadata. Their historical endpoints were not independently reopened or compared byte-for-byte.
Normal page text and transcluded tooltip/template text can have different maintenance histories; a displayed item-page revision does not freeze every transclusion.

The item tooltip parentheticals describing an additional hit are outside this audit's adoption. Only the stated Doubleshot amounts and bonus types are used; existing damage-resolution wording is unchanged.
The evidence supports a conditional selected configuration. It does not establish ownership, completed crafting, equipped activation, or live combat behavior.
Quickblade's Doublestrike text is retained as source context but no new Doublestrike calculator qualification is proposed.

exact_excerpts.ordinary_colorless: Note: The on-screen description of Augment Slots neglect to mention that Colorless augments can be used anywhere. It's good to mentally add the words "...and Colorless" to the description. For instance, "This item has a Purple Augment Slot. It can be combined with a Blue, Red, or Colorless Augment."
exact_excerpts.minimum_level: Every augment has an associated minimum level requirement to use it. Slotting any augment also increases the slotted item’s minimum level to the level of the slotted augment for as long as that augment is slotted, unless the item's minimum level is already equal or higher.
exact_excerpts.set_augment_rules: These level 30 Set augments can be slotted in any augment color slot. The item into which they are slotted becomes part of a unique three-piece item set. They can be crafted in the Hut from Beyond (lower north harbor) in the Cauldron of Cadence. Be aware that slotting a Set Augment into an item with any existing sets will suppress those sets while the Set Augment is slotted, so you should avoid slotting set augments into items that are part of sets you intend to complete.

exact_excerpts.activation: A set bonus provides additional effects when the appropriate number of items in that same "set" are worn together.
exact_excerpts.deactivation: Set bonuses are lost if the number of items worn falls below the minimum, and return when the correct number is met again, allowing a character to gear-swap in the middle of a quest and then swap back.
exact_excerpts.no_extra_reward: Wearing more than the listed number of items does not give additional bonuses unless the set bonus states such (see next).
exact_excerpts.augment_sets: Collect 3 of the same BtC raid loot across your account. Take them to the Cauldron of Cadence in the Hut from Beyond and combine them with 50 Threads of Fate and an Empty Soul Vessel each, to forge BtA Colorless Augments. Then slot them into 3 items across equipment slots of one character to gain 3 piece Set Bonueses listed below. Be aware that slotting a Set Augment into an item with any existing sets will suppress those sets while the Set Augment is slotted. For the list of other Essence Augments see Augment Slot#Essence augments.

observations.scope: Three items across equipment slots, equipped threshold, and existing-set suppression. The anchor alone is not the numeric reward source.
